# @three-ws/copy-mcp

> Manage your three.ws copy-trade follows from any AI agent — follow/unfollow leaders, tune sizing & guard rules, read the copy-intent inbox, and track fees owed. Account-scoped, non-custodial, over the live API.

@three-ws/copy-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/copy-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/copy-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/copy-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/copy-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/copy-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
